inputs.variation: each of8 bits at every byte,256 full-byte patterns,256 LCG-generated mixed preimages; zero only a comparison baseline

conclusions: Encoded preimage low2 bits are observable in frame bytes; no all-zero production substitution is justified.
Encoded byte bits2..7 are universally masked before use in the recovered transform chains; requiring their historical values overstates data dependency.
Fully written C++ byte representations are still required; capture all8 actual bits is a straightforward binding.
Native wide/key predicate stability across sampled variants does not prove universal protocol equivalence, equality semantics or byte independence.
Narrow comparison on seed representations is recorded only as data; its semantic applicability to seeds is unproven.
The raw8 random-output bytes are distinct from encoded bytes; A5FA70 consumes their64 individual bits.
Protocol/temporary default initialization does not clear payload; a new brace initializer or zero fill would replace the preimage.
Current allocation provider can leak new context storage on exception; proposed capture must use RAII until successful publication.

proposed_contract.heap: Receive exact newly allocated context address; default initialize without braces, hold RAII, capture before any lock allocation/payload write, copy observed representation back, release RAII on success.
proposed_contract.temporary: Receive exact actual Wide.bytes address; default initialize Wide without braces, create/store lock first, capture payload before transform; destroy newly created lock if custom capture provider throws.
proposed_contract.random: Real host calls CryptGenRandom into actual uninitialized local8 buffer; immediately leaf-capture actual bytes including failure remainder, copy to output and mark all known; preserve API LastError for caller.
proposed_contract.capture: No-inline MSVC Win32 x86 leaf using MOV/REP MOVSB, preserving ESI/EDI; valid distinct owned ranges; no APIs, allocation, TLS, locks or callbacks; Win32 DF-clear ABI required.
proposed_contract.representation: Observed current-process allocation/temporary bytes; not original-game heap/stack history, ABI parity, cryptographic randomness or a fabricated successful output.

Frame bytes differ, even where sampled wide comparison results agree.
No whole native frame execution, endpoint compatibility or game-runtime validation.
Capture is explicit MSVC x86 machine-storage observation; not portable ISO C++ treatment of indeterminate values.
